notes: Refit under the sensitivity harness to confirm it reproduces the FINAL run.

selection_rule: Keep CoCs with a modeling row in all 13 usable v2 target years (2012;2013;2014;2015;2016;2017;2018;2019;2020;2022;2023;2024;2025).

label: Persistence benchmark (reliable prior PIT)
selection_rule: Keep rows whose predictor_year PIT rate is present, has an FY2024 denominator, and carries pit_count_caution_flag == 0. Prior rate is the CoC's own predictor_year (t) PIT rate; the target is year t+1.
notes: Dropped 70 primary rows; every predictor_year == 2021 row is excluded because the 2021 PIT is COVID-disrupted.

label: Persistence benchmark (full-enumeration prior PIT)
selection_rule: S4 eligibility plus: prior count_type must be a full sheltered-and-unsheltered enumeration (excludes sheltered-only and partial-unsheltered prior counts).
notes: Stricter eligibility variant; drops 151 further rows beyond S4.

label: No FHFA home-price index; FL-518 restored
selection_rule: v2 pipeline rebuilt from the same audited inputs with coc_relative_home_price_index_2000_base dropped from the predictor set and from the complete-case requirement. No imputation; no v1 column used.
notes: Restores 11 rows across 1 CoC(s) (FL-518). FL-518 supplies 11 of 14 candidate-panel rows; 3 remain excluded for other missing predictors.
